passages.note: Aye on Assembly concurrence in Senate amendments, the final Assembly vote on the chaptered text; 16 Noes of 77 voting is not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law
passages.note: Chaptered text Fong voted on at concurrence; Section 220.5 forbids disclosure-requiring rules, while 220.3 only says staff shall not be required to disclose (no duty to withhold), excluding rung 1.

rows.reasoning: Fong voted Aye (61-16) on final Assembly concurrence in AB 1955 (2023-2024), whose operative Section 220.5 says schools and boards 'shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose' a pupil's gender identity without the pupil's consent. That matches 'Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents'; it does not reach 'Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents', since the bill only removes a duty to disclose and imposes no duty to withhold.
